note: A SEPARATE file on purpose: gaps.json is GENERATED by _build_gaps.py, so a hand-added status field there would be wiped on the next regeneration. Every status here is the RESULT of a mechanical probe, and the probe is named so a reader can check the probe rather than trust the answer. Re-run the script to re-verify.

status_vocabulary.closed: the gap's claim no longer holds, and a probe proves it
status_vocabulary.partial: part of the gap is addressed; the probe measures how much
status_vocabulary.open: the gap's claim still holds, and a probe proves it
status_vocabulary.not_attempted: recorded and untouched -- nobody has measured it
